values.note: Operator's price list (headed 'Attention campers, new prices will be coming in 2026!', still posted Oct 2026): water/electric $40 a night ($240 week, $600 month plus metered electric), full hookup $50 ($300 week, $725 month); rustic sites $33 (whether RVs use them is not stated). Rates cover 2 adults and 3 children; extra guests $5 per person per night. Honey-wagon pump-out $10 (Mon/Wed/Fri). Good Sam: 10% off the daily rate only ($36 / $45).

note: Family-owned private RV park at 580 M-72 SE on the edge of Kalkaska; ~93-105 sites, pool, game room, 40 acres of nature trails, cabins. Not on water. --Claude
summary: Operator site: water/electric $40, full hookup $50 (posted with '2026 prices coming', still current), rustic $33, Good Sam 10%, season May 1 - Nov 20, camping.com booking engine. Changed fees 50-50 -> 40-50 (W/E is the base), season -> 05-01..11-20 (note's 'Apr-Oct' was wrong), added showers/dump/wifi, booking platform/url, confirmed Good Sam, water/sewer. Not stated: amperage, max rig length (60 ft derived left), site count. Engine quote not obtained (the date form did not submit).
flags: Long-stay check: weekly and monthly rates and seasonal requests exist, but nightly rates are posted and sold through an online engine; the seasonal share is not published (not determinable from the pages).
Price gate: base $40 a night (water/electric) on the operator's price list, which is undated beyond 'new prices will be coming in 2026'; under US$50.
